---
name: Clarity, accessibility or process feedback
about: Suggest one small improvement without sharing candidate data.
title: "[Feedback] "
---

## Public-data check

This issue is public. Do not include résumés, contacts, private career evidence or feedback, full prompts/conversations, workspace files, identifying job URLs, credentials or tokens. Describe the process with fictional examples.

- [ ] I have removed personal, confidential and secret information.

## What felt difficult or unclear?

Name the guide or step. Separate what you observed from your interpretation.

## One suggested improvement

What small change might help, and for whom? “Leave it unchanged” is a valid outcome.

## How could we check whether it helps?

Suggest an observable, bounded check such as fewer repeated questions or clearer next actions. A callback, rejection or small sample does not establish causation or justify a permanent ranking rule.

## Fictional example, if useful

Keep it short and invented. No real candidate documents or identifying details.
